visual.general_description: Row of five grayscale brain MRI panels (T2WI, FLAIR axial, FLAIR sagittal, T1WI, T1WI+C) with white arrows marking lesion regions on four of them.
visual.detailed_description: T2WI: Axial T2-weighted brain MRI slice with four white arrows pointing at central white matter. FLAIR (A): Axial FLAIR brain MRI slice with four white arrows pointing at central white matter. FLAIR (S): Sagittal FLAIR brain MRI slice with three white arrows pointing at the region adjacent to the corpus callosum. T1WI: Axial pre-contrast T1-weighted brain MRI slice without arrows. T1WI+C: Axial post-contrast T1-weighted brain MRI slice with one white arrow pointing at the white matter on the image right of the midline.

panels.general_description: Axial T2-weighted brain MRI slice with four white arrows pointing at central white matter.
panels.detailed_description: Grayscale axial slice through the upper brain. The label T2WI is printed in white at lower left. Four white block arrows point toward the central white matter on either side of the midline: two arrows from the upper left and upper right pointing inward and downward, one arrow from the left pointing right, and one arrow from the lower right pointing up and left. Cerebrospinal fluid spaces and sulci appear bright against darker brain tissue. Two small faint bright spots lie just right of the image midline beside the tips of the two right-sided arrows; no other focal lesion is distinguishable from background signal at this resolution.

panels.general_description: Sagittal FLAIR brain MRI slice with three white arrows pointing at the region adjacent to the corpus callosum.
panels.detailed_description: Grayscale sagittal head slice with the label FLAIR (S) printed in white at lower left. The arched corpus callosum is visible across the middle; the cerebellum, brainstem and the skull base and neck region are visible below. Three white block arrows point at the area adjacent to the upper margin of the corpus callosum: two arrows close together from the upper left pointing down and right, and one arrow from the upper right pointing down and left. Faint brighter areas lie along the callosal margin near the arrow tips.
